from ninja import Router, Schema
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import Project, Milestone

class MilestoneOut(Schema):
    id: int
    title: str
    deadline: str
    deliverables_summary: str

router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}", response=MilestoneOut)
def get_project_milestone(request, project_id: int, milestone_id: int):
    project = get_object_or_404(Project, id=project_id)
    if not project.collaborators.filter(id=request.auth.id).exists():
        raise PermissionDenied("Access denied to project")
    milestone = get_object_or_404(Milestone, id=milestone_id)
    return milestone
diagnosis: Although the view validates that request.auth is an approved collaborator on project_id, it queries Milestone solely by milestone_id without ensuring milestone.project_id == project_id. An attacker with access to any single project can view confidential milestones from other private projects by changing milestone_id.

corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, Schema
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import Project, Milestone

class MilestoneOut(Schema):
    id: int
    title: str
    deadline: str
    deliverables_summary: str

router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}", response=MilestoneOut)
def get_project_milestone(request, project_id: int, milestone_id: int):
    project = get_object_or_404(Project, id=project_id)
    if not project.collaborators.filter(id=request.auth.id).exists():
        raise PermissionDenied("Access denied to project")
    milestone = get_object_or_404(Milestone, id=milestone_id, project=project)
    return milestone
